93.fbtext:
«اللهُ أَكْثَرُ» 🤍
"Allah gives even more."

A hadith about du'a: no du'a is ever lost. Allah answers it, or turns away an equal harm from you, or keeps it for you until the Day of Resurrection. So make lots of du'a: for yourself, your family and your parents.

What du'a do you keep making, even when the answer seems slow?
Follow Taqwa Lantern for daily reminders 🤍

🎙️ الشيخ عثمان الخميس | Sheikh Othman Al-Khamees
Hadith: Musnad Ahmad 11133 (Abu Sa'id al-Khudri), authentic; told in his words. Translation: HadeethEnc.com. Note: his opening scene (unanswered du'as found as good deeds on the Day of Resurrection) is from a weak report (al-Hakim 1819; al-Albani: da'if); its core meaning is authentic (Musnad Ahmad 11133). English subtitles: Taqwa Lantern translation.

#الدعاء #dua #hadith

«والله يا أبي، الكلمات لا توفيك حقّك» 🤍
"By Allah, Father, words cannot give you your due."

Words for a father: everything he carried for you, quietly, for years. Make du'a for him today, whether he is still with you or not.

What is one thing your father did for you that you never thanked him for?
